project_info.theme: Vinamilk SuSu two-flavor ice cream launch
project_info.color_palette: Light lime green, pastel pink, soft yellow, black typography, fruit colors

main_subject.detail: A playful illustrated product poster with three oversized two-tone ice cream bars standing upright. The top banner says 'Vinamilk SuSu' and the huge headline reads 'KEM HAI VỊ VUI GẤP ĐÔI!'. At the upper-right product window are three packaged bars labeled kiwi-lychee, strawberry-melon, and peach-lychee. A pink starburst says 'MỚI!'.
main_subject.style: Cute pastel commercial illustration with thick outlines, kid-friendly fruit graphics, and cheerful mascot doodles

composition_elements.text: Vinamilk SuSu; KEM HAI VỊ VUI GẤP ĐÔI!; MỚI!; KEM TUYẾT KIWI HƯƠNG VẢI; KEM TUYẾT DÂU DƯA LƯỚI; KEM TUYẾT ĐÀO HƯƠNG VẢI
items: Top Left: Yellow Vinamilk SuSu header tabs and a row of yellow circles
Top Right: Product-packaging showcase panel with three flavor wrappers
Bottom Left: Fruit illustrations and a tiny winter-clothes character
Bottom Right: Pink 'MỚI!' burst and three playful cartoon kids sliding and pointing
Center/Background: Three giant pastel dual-flavor popsicles on a mint-green illustrated background

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Soft grain texture, pastel color fill, clean glossy highlights on popsicles

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square illustrated product poster for a Vinamilk SuSu two-flavor ice cream launch. Centerpiece is a playful pastel composition with three oversized dual-flavor popsicles and the exact large headline 'KEM HAI VỊ VUI GẤP ĐÔI!'. Include the 'Vinamilk SuSu' top banner, the pink 'MỚI!' starburst, and the packaging callouts 'KEM TUYẾT KIWI HƯƠNG VẢI', 'KEM TUYẾT DÂU DƯA LƯỚI', and 'KEM TUYẾT ĐÀO HƯƠNG VẢI'. Background is a mint-green kid-friendly illustration field with fruits and cartoon children. Surrounding elements: packaging window at upper right, small fruit cutouts, and playful mascot doodles. Technical style: polished commercial illustration poster, flat cheerful illustration lighting, pastel grain texture and glossy popsicle highlights, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
